name: Spinach Balls
author: Chris Crawley
steps: Microwave spinach as package directions call for and drain well.
Put into large sized bowl and add the stuffing mix, then mix well with fork.
Finely chop and add the onion, then mix well with fork.
Add the seasonings, then mix well with fork.
Melt and add the margarine (or butter), then mix well with fork.
Beat and add the eggs, then mix well with fork.
Add the parmesan cheese, then mix well with fork.
Form into balls and put on cookie sheet. Bake at 325 degrees for about 20 minutes. Watch closely as the bottoms might burn.

You can make up the spinach balls and put on cookie sheets and freeze for a couple of hours. Then put in a Ziploc bag until ready to cook. Put frozen balls on cookie sheets and thaw about an hour, and then cook as above.
